title: Shortcut Guide: add Ableton Live shortcut manifest

status.label: Review blocked on manifest design
status.detail: One of the three permitted Copilot review iterations has completed. Nine unresolved threads remain: the manifest declares a semicolon-separated list of Ableton executables, but the current schema and matcher support only one exact executable or *. Replacing it with one executable would silently exclude editions; enabling lists requires a coordinated schema and matcher design with coverage. The package-less identifier, section casing, and spelling notices remain coupled to this unfinalized manifest correction. No fresh review was requested.

next_action: Manually resolve the coordinated manifest schema and matcher design before resuming review.

actions.note: No upstream review action is proposed until the manifest design is resolved.
